name: Trading Capacity 6 Code
definition: Specifies the role of a trading party in a transaction.

AGEN.name: Agent
AGEN.definition: Trading as Agent on behalf of a customer.

BAGN.name: Acting Agent
BAGN.definition: Party acting as an agent for both customer and another person.

OAGN.name: Other Agent
OAGN.definition: Acting as an agent for a party other than a customer.

PRAG.name: Principal Agent
PRAG.definition: Acting as an agent for some executions and principal for others in the same transaction.
